name: CrazeAI Quality Mix v1
purpose: Train a compact general assistant without copying another model's weights or proprietary corpus.
quality_rules: filter unsafe and low-quality generated text
prefer factual educational material with clear provenance
keep code syntactically complete where possible
include tool-use and current-information examples without embedding fake search results
note: Use only datasets whose licenses permit the intended use. This manifest describes the training strategy; it does not redistribute third-party datasets.
